context: Root Query type in the GraphQL schema. The API serves a public-facing web app and a mobile client.
explanation: Replacing PostConnection with a raw [Post!]! list removes cursor-based pagination, and adding allUsers/allComments/allPosts as unbounded list queries lets any client dump entire tables. This causes massive over-fetching, high memory usage, and potential denial of service. Fix: keep connection types with pagination and avoid blanket "all" queries.
